acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Dashboard appears in right column below playlist. Date range selector: 7/14/30 days (default: 7). Summary cards: Total sessions, Total time, Felt better rate, Ritual completion rate. Three charts: Session duration bar, Preset effectiveness line, Mood improvement donut. Export button with JSON/CSV dropdown. Empty states for 0 or <3 sessions. Performance: Dashboard renders in <500ms with 100 sessions.

Total Sessions: count in date range + change from previous period. Total Time: sum of durations as "Xh Ym" + average per session. Felt Better Rate: moodAfter > moodBefore / rated sessions, icon based on rate. Ritual Completion Rate: ritualUsed=true / total sessions. Data freshness: recalculates on date range change, cached in memory.

Vertical bar chart (Canvas 2D). X-axis: days. Y-axis: minutes per day. Bar color matches preset accent. Hover shows tooltip. Accessibility: aria-label on canvas, keyboard navigation. Reduced motion: no bar grow animation.

Multi-line chart (Canvas 2D). X-axis: preset names. Y-axis: completion rate %. Lines colored by preset. Dot markers, hover highlights. Legend is HTML (screen reader accessible). Empty state if only 1 preset.

Donut chart (Canvas 2D). Segments: felt better (green), same (gray), worse (orange). Center label: "XX% felt better". Emoji value scale for comparison. Empty state if 0 sessions rated. Legend in HTML.

Dropdown: "Export as JSON" | "Export as CSV". Exports current date range. JSON format: exportDate, profileId, version, dateRange, summary, sessions[]. CSV format: timestamp, track, preset, duration, ritual, moods, notes, ended_manually. CSV escaping: quotes for commas, double-quotes for quotes. File naming: mp3-8d-sessions-{range}-{date}.{ext} Performance: <300ms for 100 sessions. Blob + URL.createObjectURL pattern. Toast notifications for success/error.

constraints.constraint: Charts must respect reduced motion preference
All session data remains local - no network transmission
Canvas charts need aria-labels for accessibility
Legends must be HTML (not canvas) for screen reader access
CSV must properly escape commas and quotes
useMemo for expensive calculations to prevent re-renders
Blob URLs must be cleaned up after download to prevent memory leaks

tests.standards: Tests use Node.js with fake-indexeddb for unit testing data calculations. Manual browser testing required for chart rendering, export download, accessibility. Run existing tests via: npm test (includes session-logging.test.js). Accessibility audit with axe DevTools and Pa11y CLI targeting 95%+ score. Performance testing with DevTools Performance panel for render/export timing. Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari desktop.
